title: Roadmap Orchestrator: dependency flows and safety guardrails
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a lightweight Roadmap Orchestrator service and workflow to surface and manage cross-team dependencies (Engineering, Design, Security, Infra) for quarterly initiatives. The goal is to provide a single source of truth for readiness signals (design complete, infra capacity, security signoff), automatic gating for critical-path items, and an escalation flow that reduces manual status hunting during cutover windows. The scope includes a Linear-integrated dependency registry, a risk-scoring engine, Slack/Email escalation playbooks, Console dashboard telemetry for teams to see dependency health, and runbook hooks for canary/rollback decisions.
acceptance_criteria: A Linear-integrated registry where PMs can add/update dependency entries that include owner, type, readiness state, and expected impact window
Risk scoring algorithm implemented and visible on the Console dependency dashboard (risk = probability * impact) with adjustable weights per project
Automated gating rules that can mark an initiative as blocked if any P0 security dependency is unresolved or if infra capacity threshold is breached
Slack escalation flow that triggers when a dependency slips milestone by >3 business days and includes owner, PR/Design links, and required action
Console dashboard shows per-initiative readiness percentage, top-3 blocking dependencies, and per-team backlog of dependent work
Playbook documented and verified with at least two tabletop drills involving Eng, Design, Security, and Infra teams
